tadāyatana.p: [Ta+āyatana] (na) CL=7 That object or issue which is cause of location, (A) Nibbāna. (B) Arahattaphala. (C) first Jhāna. (F) fourth Jhāna, (G) Ākāsānañcāyatana jhāna. (H) Viññāṇañcāyatana jhāna. (I) Ākiñcaññāyatana jhāna. (J) Nevasaññānāsaññāyatana jhāna. (H) Saññāvedayita nirodhasamāpatti. (Saññāvedayita means perception and felt experience) (Nirodhasamāpatti means attainment of cessation). (Ākāsānañcāyatana means dimension of infinite space; base of infinity of space) ( Viññāṇañcāyatana means dimension of infinite consciousness) (Ākiñcaññāyatana means dimension of nothingness; sphere of emptiness; base of nothingness) (Nevasaññānāsaññāyatana means  dimension of neither perception nor non-perception).
a: ထို...ဟူသော-တည်ရာ-အကြောင်း၊(က)နိဗ္ဗာန်။(ခ)အရဟတ္တဖိုလ်။(ဂ)ပဌမဈာန်။(စ)စတုတ္ထဈာန်။(ဆ)အာကာသာနဉ္စာယတနဈာန်။(ဇ)ဝိညာဏဉ္စာယတနဈာန်။(ဈ)အာကိဉ္စညာယတနဈာန်။(ည)နေဝသညာနာသညာယတနဈာန်။(ဋ)သညာဝေဒယိတနိရောဓသမာပတ်။
